0022600142.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 4-0 and riding a four-game winning streak, are on the road for their fifth game of the season and sit 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West. The Dallas Mavericks are 2-2, 7th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, and they are without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) listed as day-to-day. For Oklahoma City, Cason Wallace (shoulder), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee) are out, Alex Caruso (ankle) and Chet Holmgren (knee) are day-to-day, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 100-87 win in Dallas on March 1, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
